items.t: Organigram and Aurora File Joint Management Information Circular in Support of Arrangement Agreement to Establish a Global Cannabis Leader
items.sum: TORONTO & EDMONTON, Alberta, November 25, 2026--Organigram Global Inc. (NASDAQ: OGI) (TSX: OGI) ("Organigram") and Aurora Cannabis Inc. items.t: Aurora Cannabis CEO Makes the Case for Organigram’s Offer Over Curaleaf’s
items.sum: Aurora CEO Miguel Martin discusses why the company is going with Organigram over Curaleaf and what’s next, in an exclusive interview.

items.t: Organigram and Aurora Take the Stage at Talman London After C$561 Million Deal Announcement
items.sum: LJUBLJANA, SI / ACCESS Newswire / November 24, 2026 / Leaders from Organigram Global Inc. made their first public appearance at the Talman House investor event in London after announcing an agreement in which Organigram would acquire all issued and outstanding common shares of Aurora, if the pending deal becomes final.
